title: Wildfront Horizon
name: Wildfront Horizon
description: A full 3D hunting experience built from engineering blueprints: track living wildlife across five reserves with wind and scent, real ballistics and scopes, tracking sign and recovery, graded PERFECT/GREAT/GOOD shots, a trophy lodge and a field guide — twelve progressive contracts plus free hunts.
